name: resonant
description: Secure AI job-finding agent portfolio project.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: python3 scripts/api_python.py -m ruff check apps/api tests evals
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/shared run typecheck
scripts.test:api: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 scripts/api_python.py -m pytest tests/api tests/security evals/deepeval
scripts.eval:promptfoo: PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/resonant-promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_WAL_MODE=true npx promptfoo@0.122.2 eval -c evals/promptfoo/promptfooconfig.yaml --no-progress-bar
